_comment: Verified third-party uses of the ElkassabgiData libraries. EVIDENCE IS REQUIRED: every entry carries a url that was fetched and a verbatim quote or code path that was read. Nothing goes in here on the strength of a search-result snippet alone. Maintained by tools/track_uses.py; the page is rendered by tools/gen_used_by_page.py.

uses.title: Online Conformal Prediction for Non-Exchangeable Panel Data
uses.how: One of the paper's three real-data panels is built from HF Data Library clean U.S. equity data, Clean version, Hourly timeframe. The HF panel covers the second half of 2024 (2024-07-02 to 2024-12-31), targets next-hour return, and splits 495 start-aligned tickers into 395 calibration and 100 test tickers over a 500-hour horizon.
uses.quote: For the HF panel, we use the HF Data Library clean U.S. equity data, selecting the Clean version and Hourly timeframe from the download/API portal https://hfdatalibrary.com/pages/download.
uses.reference: [13] Ahmed Elkassabgi. HF Data Library: High-Frequency U.S. Equity Data (1-Minute OHLCV). Zenodo dataset, version 1.0, 2026. URL https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19501605.
uses.evidence: Text extracted from the arXiv PDF (34 pages) locally; reference [13] and the 'Data access and licenses' paragraph both read verbatim.

uses.title: TradeMood
uses.how: A commercial trading-readiness app. Its market-complexity service is built on historical SPY data from the HF Data Library and served to the app through the vendor's own endpoint (api.urticad.com/api/v1/complexity/mkt); the app itself sends only the ticker symbol. The privacy policy carries the CC BY attribution and passes through the library's own post-March-2022 IEX caveat.
uses.quote: The market service uses historical SPY data from HF Data Library, cited as Elkassabgi, A. (2026), HF Data Library: Free 1-Minute Intraday U.S. Equity Data, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.19501605
uses.evidence: Privacy policy fetched and read; attribution and IEX passthrough quoted verbatim.

uses.title: stock_drawdown_risk_ml_research
uses.how: An ML research repository that downloads from the HF API, keeps a data/manifests/ATTRIBUTION.md carrying both the CC BY credit and the IEX terms passthrough, snapshots the library's own API and documentation pages with SHA-256 hashes (scripts/snapshot_provider_documents.py), and engages with the published survivorship-bias limitation in research/expanded_universe/survivorship_bias_assessment.md.
uses.evidence: GitHub code search matched hfdatalibrary.com, api.hfdatalibrary.com and zenodo.19501605 in this repository; file paths and fragments read.

uses.title: borsa-dashboard-training
uses.how: A dashboard/training project that lists the HF Data Library as a source for hourly OHLCV in its README and pulls it live: scripts/fetch_hourly_data.py and scripts/build_multi_dataset.py both request /v1/download-token/{ticker} with version=clean, format=parquet, with retry handling.
uses.evidence: GitHub code search matched api.hfdatalibrary.com in two scripts and the README source table; fragments read.

uses.title: ElkassabgiData MCP server listing
uses.how: A third-party MCP directory lists the ElkassabgiData MCP server, making the libraries discoverable to AI assistants outside the project's own pages.
uses.evidence: Appeared as an independent domain in search results for the MCP server; listing not yet fetched in full.

uses.title: WebsiteLaunches daily listing (#27, 2026-07-18)
uses.how: IP Data Library was listed as #27 in the daily launches for 2026-07-18 under Category 'Legal Services', with a description of the free, citation-rich patent and trademark data drawn from US government sources.
uses.quote: IP Data Library is a research-focused platform that provides free, citation-rich patent and trademark data drawn from US government sources, designed for researchers and analysts.
uses.evidence: Found by tools/track_uses.py; the listing file 2026/07/2026-07-18.md was fetched from the WebsiteLaunches/daily-website-launches repository and the entry read verbatim.

uses.title: swarm-notes-ts (notes vault)
uses.how: Not an independent use: a personal notes vault holding a copy of arXiv:2605.17705, whose text mentions the download portal. Recorded so it stops resurfacing as a candidate, and to keep the distinction between a use and a mention explicit.
uses.evidence: vault/raw/papers/2605.17705.md fetched and read; the matching text is the paper's own 'Data access and licenses' paragraph.
